F1_validation: Validation of the C0–C7 FEBio model against Herron et al. 2020 (26-year-old subject). (a) One-direction C0–C7 rotation under a 1.5 N m pure moment at C0 (C7 fixed, nucleus pre-pressure 0.1 MPa); error bars, ±2° reading uncertainty of the digitised reference. (b) Total range of motion per level in lateral bending (LB) and axial rotation (AR). (c) C3–C4 facet force at 1.5 N m. 18 of 22 compared quantities are within 10 % of the reference; the largest deviations are at C0–C1 (LB +21 %, AR −14 %).
F2_design_space: Screening map of the 136 human-designed cage configurations with an evaluated implanted state (of 150 active-learning points, 133 unique). (a) Worst-direction friction coefficient required to prevent dislocation (μ_req, tied-interface limit-surface analysis at the state where the driving moment reaches 1.5 N m under a 100 N follower load) against the sustained compression of the soft PLCL phase after implantation (99th-percentile element compression at t = 3.5). (b) Peak soft-PLCL compression in any of the six directions against the sustained value; dashed lines, the interim rule (15 % sustained, 25 % peak). Colours give the current verdict; markers the cage family. Every evaluated design needs μ_req < 0.17, well below the assumed available friction of 0.3; compression of the soft phase, not slip, is the discriminating failure.
F3_verdict_breakdown: Verdict of the 148 valid active-learning designs by design factor (two points were invalid at build time). Pass = all six directions reach 1.5 N m with the tied interface and the soft-PLCL compression rule holds (sustained ≤ 15 %, peak ≤ 25 %); fail = the compression rule is violated; undetermined = at least one direction did not reach the target moment or the implantation run did not converge (12 designs invert under the 100 N follower load). Soft-phase modulus is the dominant factor: designs with E_soft below 3 MPa rarely pass.
F4_split_validation: Independent-window protocol validated on design p062 (family A, axial mixing-nozzle gradient, d = 0.5 mm). Each direction is restarted from the implanted state (t = 3.5) instead of following the previous direction. (a) Required friction coefficient and (b) one-face slip bound agree within 1 % in flexion and lateral bending; the 4–9 % higher slip bounds in extension and axial rotation follow the (c) moment at the first converged step past the 1.5 N m target (ratios 1.09, 1.05, 1.08), i.e. the sampling of the target crossing, not a different mechanical response.
F5_insertion_failures: Designs whose implantation run cannot be completed. Of the 42 designs re-run with the independent-window protocol, 13 stop with inverted soft-PLCL elements during the 100 N follower-load step (t = 3.0–3.4; two during insertion), in every solver mode tried (static, slow dynamic, restart). (a) They cluster at the lowest soft-phase moduli; (b) failure fraction by E_soft bin. Whether element inversion under 100 N is reported as a compression failure or as a non-computable case is a pending decision.
F6_compute: Compute use of the FEBio pipeline (scheduler log, 2026-10-20 to 10-31): 10,196 CPU core-hours and 1,005 GPU-hours over 29 job records; bars, core-hours per day; line, cumulative. The 10-21 to 10-23 peak is the ISO/compression active-learning screen (two tests × 150 points); later batches are the physiological-rotation protocol and its re-runs after the 10-26 load-curve fix. One shared host: 32-core cgroup quota, 4 of 7 A100 GPUs.
F7_mu_by_direction: Friction coefficient needed to prevent dislocation, per loading direction, over all designs whose window reached 1.5 N m (tied-interface limit-surface analysis; dots, designs; bars, median and quartiles). Lateral bending governs fixation (median μ_req ≈ 0.12), flexion–extension needs an order of magnitude less; all values lie below the assumed available friction of 0.3, so for this design family dislocation is not the limiting failure under 1.5 N m pure moments with a 100 N follower load.
